config.fluentSetters.description: If enabled, setters will return `$this` for chained calls (`public function setProp(): self`).
config.getterPrefix.description: Prefix for getter methods of non-boolean properties (example: *get*Name).
config.getterBoolPrefix.description: Prefix for getter methods of boolean properties (example: *is*Active).
config.addVoidToSetters.description: Whether to add the `: void` return type for standard setters (ignored if fluent style is enabled).
config.fluentSettersReturnType.descripti: Choose the return type for generated setters.
config.fluentSettersReturnType.enum1desc: Setter return type will be class name (`pubilc function setProp($val): ClassName`).
config.fluentSettersReturnType.enum2desc: Setter return type will be static (`pubilc function setProp($val): static`).
config.indentation.description: Choose the indentation style for generated getters and setters.
config.indentation.enum2description: Use `4 spaces` for method indentation (`PSR` standard).
